cases.description: Verify complete flow from launch to selection.
steps: 1. Install and launch the app. 2. Verify Splash Screen with HP logo and "sprocket". 3. Wait for splash to complete. 4. Tap Get Started. 5. Tap Sign Up Later. 6. Wait for Home screen. 7. Allow notification permission (if displayed). 8. Tap Pre-Cut Stickers. 9. Allow Photos & Videos permission. 10. Tap Allow. 11. Tap Got It on info popup. 12. Verify Pre-Cut screen: Back, Select 2 Photos, disabled Next button, first slot selected (green), second slot disabled (grey), gallery displayed.
cases.expected: User reaches the Pre-Cut selection screen with empty slots and disabled Next button.

verifications.description: Verify complete flow from launch to selection.
verifications.expected: User reaches the Pre-Cut selection screen with empty slots and disabled Next button.

cases.description: Verify 2-photo selection, duplicate prevention, and next state.
